title: CVE-2017-5638 (S2-045) RCE via OGNL injection in Struts2 multipart Content-Type
description: Apache Struts2 portal-svc running struts2-core 2.3.31 is vulnerable to CVE-2017-5638 (S2-045). Attacker can inject OGNL expressions via Content-Type header in multipart upload requests, leading to RCE. 847 exploit attempts detected 08:15Z. Immediate upgrade to 2.3.32 (fix commit 35230649) required. GHSA-j77q-2qqg-6989.

title: Audit all Struts2 versions across services and upgrade to 2.3.32+
description: Following CVE-2017-5638 exploitation attempt, audit all services using Apache Struts2 and upgrade to 2.3.32 or 2.5.10.1. Add WAF rule blocking OGNL patterns in Content-Type header. Add dependency scanning to CI pipeline.
